name: app-dotted-orange-on-black-aiot-dashboard-tile-wall
title: Dot-Matrix AIoT Dashboard Tile Wall
whatItIs: A warm gradient poster with a dot-matrix title and a 3-by-4 grid of tilted black tiles, each a numbered widget drawn from dots and lines: agent status, tokens chart, device ring, car status, pill progress, medical monitor, bio sensor, word game, retail analytics, music, space game and vision AI.
whatItMeans: Everything drawn in dots with only orange-red accents feels like a retro display and makes twelve different widgets one family.
techniques: Dot-matrix drawing for icons, charts and rings
One orange-red accent on black tiles
Tiles slightly tilted like a wall of screens
bestFor: Data visualisation in a single style

vocabulary.definition: Graphics built from a grid of small dots.
Many small dashboard tiles arranged in a grid.
Small technical text set in a fixed-width font.
